provenance.notes: Synthetic HTML article for the exact-article Stage 3 offline test. No real publisher was contacted; example.com is the reserved documentation domain (RFC 2606) and every value is a bracketed or obviously-placeholder string. The <title> carries an undecoded entity so the test pins that the reported headline is a verbatim fragment of the bytes while the decoded title is derived.
